title: CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction
title_zh: CineRecon：面向智能体电影重建的前沿模型基准测试

paragraphs.en: Reconstructing reference videos as editable dynamic 3D scenes is an important path toward controllable video generation for filmmaking: these scenes provide modifiable, renderable visual proxies that enable explicit control over scene layout, subject actions, and camera behavior. To evaluate agents’ ability to reconstruct editable dynamic 3D scenes from dynamic reference videos, we introduce CineRecon , a benchmark comprising 50 reference videos and 360 annotated evaluation clips. The reference videos span film, real-world footage, and games. Given a complete video, an agent uses tools to construct, animate, render, and refine its reconstruction. We evaluate this task under three representation settings: Proxy , Simplified , and Detailed . These settings increase geometric and appearance requirements while retaining the same requirements for spatial relations, camera behavior, and subject dynamics. This design tests whether agents can reproduce the events in a video when detailed appearance is unnecessary, and how performance changes as representation requirements increase. For evaluation, we construct checklists that associate observable properties and events with specific entities and times. A vision-language judge compares timestamp-aligned reference and rendered frames across 11 categories, grouped into camera, static, and dynamic consistency dimensions. We evaluate 12 models using their corresponding agent harnesses and find failures across all three dimensions. Subject motions and interactions remain difficult to reproduce even under the Proxy setting.
paragraphs.zh: 将参考视频重构为可编辑的动态 3D 场景，是迈向可控视频生成的重要路径，这对电影制作至关重要：这些场景提供了可修改、可渲染的视觉代理，从而能够明确控制场景布局、主体动作和相机行为。 为了评估智能体从动态参考视频中重构可编辑动态 3D 场景的能力，我们提出了 CineRecon——一个包含 50 个参考视频和 360 个带标注的评价剪辑的基准数据集。 这些参考视频涵盖了电影、真实世界影像和游戏内容。 给定一个完整视频，智能体会使用工具来构建、动画化、渲染并优化其重构结果。 我们在三种表示设置下对该任务进行了评估：Proxy（代理）、Simplified（简化）和 Detailed（详细）。 这些设置提高了对几何形状和外观的要求，但保留了空间关系、相机行为和主体动态方面的相同要求。 这一设计旨在测试智能体是否能在无需详细外观的情况下还原视频中的事件，并观察性能随表示要求提升而发生的变化。 在评估中，我们构建了检查清单，将可观察的属性与事件关联到特定的实体和时间点。 一个视觉-语言判评器会跨 11 个类别比较时间戳对齐的参考帧和渲染帧，这些类别被分为相机一致性、静态一致性和动态一致性三个维度。 我们使用各模型对应的智能体工具包对 12 个模型进行了评估，发现所有三个维度都存在失败情况。 即使在 Proxy 设置下，主体动作和交互仍然难以准确还原。

paragraphs.en: Precisely expressing and refining creative intent is a central requirement for bringing video generation into filmmaking [ 39 , 17 ] . Reconstructing reference videos as editable dynamic 3D scenes provides an important path toward this goal. These scenes let creators explicitly adjust spatial relations, action timing, and camera trajectories by editing layout, subject actions, and camera behavior. Their rendered outputs serve as visual proxies to guide video generation [ 20 , 32 , 10 ] . Building such proxies requires faithfully reproducing the dynamic processes in the reference video. For example, a camera follows a person approaching another person, and the two then shake hands. The agent must coordinate the person’s movement, the handshake, and the camera motion so that the interaction occurs at the correct time and location. This raises a concrete question: can agents autonomously construct editable 3D scenes from complete videos to faithfully reenact their content and events?
paragraphs.zh: 精确表达和提炼创作意图，是将视频生成技术应用于电影制作的核心要求 [ 39 , 17 ] 。 将参考视频重构为可编辑的动态 3D 场景，为实现这一目标提供了重要途径。 这些场景使创作者能够通过编辑布局、主体动作和相机行为，明确调整空间关系、动作时机和相机轨迹。 它们的渲染结果可作为视觉代理，用于指导视频生成 [ 20 , 32 , 10 ] 。 构建此类代理需要忠实地再现参考视频中的动态过程。 例如，一台相机跟随一个人走向另一个人，随后两人握手。 智能体必须协调人物的移动、握手动作和相机的运动，以确保互动在正确的时间和地点发生。 这引出了一个具体问题：智能体能否从完整视频中自主构建可编辑的 3D 场景，以忠实地重演其内容和事件？

paragraphs.en: Recent work has expanded the evaluation of graphics agents from scene editing and static reconstruction [ 15 , 40 , 30 ] to video reconstruction. BVB studies real indoor videos [ 38 ] , while 4DCodeBench examines dynamic phenomena such as deformation, fluid flow, and fracture [ 36 ] . Cinematic reconstruction requires jointly reproducing scene content, subject actions and interactions, camera motion, and shot transitions. We evaluate this joint capability using complete reference videos, without supplied scene assets or camera parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已将图形智能体的评估范围从场景编辑和静态重建 [ 15 , 40 , 30 ] 扩展到了视频重建。 BVB 研究了真实的室内视频 [ 38 ]，而 4DCodeBench 则考察了形变、流体流动和断裂等动态现象 [ 36 ]。 电影级重建需要同时再现场景内容、主体动作与互动、相机运动以及镜头转换。 我们使用完整的参考视频来评估这种综合能力，且不提供任何场景资产或相机参数。

paragraphs.en: We introduce CineRecon , a benchmark of 50 reference videos from film, real-world footage, and games. An agent receives the complete video and generic task instructions, then autonomously constructs an editable Blender scene and renders its animation. The agent can inspect rendered feedback and revise the scene. Success requires faithfully reproducing the reference video’s content and events at corresponding timestamps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CineRecon，这是一个基准数据集，包含来自电影、真实世界影像和游戏的 50 段参考视频。 智能体接收完整的视频和通用任务说明，然后自主构建一个可编辑的 Blender 场景并渲染其动画。 该智能体可以检查渲染后的反馈，并对场景进行修订。 成功的关键在于忠实地再现参考视频中对应时间戳处的内容和事件。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate reconstruction along three dimensions. Camera Consistency covers camera behavior and shot transitions. Static Consistency covers object presence, attributes, and spatial relations. Dynamic Consistency covers subject motion and action events, including interactions, deformation, and state changes, with attention to their timing. For each reference video, we construct checklists that associate observable properties and events with specific entities and times. A vision-language judge compares timestamp-aligned reference and rendered frames to assess these requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个维度评估重建效果。 相机一致性涵盖相机的行为以及镜头之间的过渡。 静态一致性涵盖物体的存在、属性以及空间关系。 动态一致性涵盖主体的运动与动作事件，包括交互、形变和状态变化，并关注这些事件发生的时间点。 对于每个参考视频，我们都会构建检查清单，将可观察的属性与事件关联到特定的实体和时间点上。 一个视觉-语言判评器会对比时间戳对齐的参考帧与渲染帧，以评估这些要求。

paragraphs.en: To examine how geometric and appearance requirements affect reconstruction performance, we define three settings for the same reference videos: Proxy , Simplified , and Detailed . They require geometric stand-ins, recognizable object structures, and reference-specific visible details, respectively. Geometric and appearance-detail requirements within Static Consistency vary across settings, while Camera and Dynamic Consistency use the same check items and spatial-relation requirements remain unchanged. This design allows us to compare reconstruction performance across representation settings and examine whether errors in reproducing dynamic events persist when appearance requirements are simplified.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究几何和外观要求如何影响重建性能，我们为相同的参考视频定义了三种设置：Proxy、Simplified 和 Detailed。 它们分别需要几何替身、可识别的对象结构以及针对参考视频的具体可见细节。 Static Consistency 中的几何和外观细节要求在不同设置中有所差异，而 Camera 和 Dynamic Consistency 使用相同的检查项，空间关系要求保持不变。 这种设计使我们能够比较不同表示设置下的重建性能，并检验在简化外观要求时，动态事件再现中的错误是否仍然存在。

The results identify spatial relations, specific action events, and camera changes as shared weaknesses across models. Cross-setting comparisons show that most models achieve higher camera and dynamic consistency scores when appearance requirements are simplified, but still struggle to reproduce action timing, contact relations, and coordinated motion between subjects accurately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对现有的多模态编码模型进行了系统性评估。 图 2 和图 3 总结了重建性能与生成成本。 结果表明，空间关系、具体动作事件和摄像头切换是各模型共有的薄弱环节。 跨场景对比显示，当外观要求简化时，大多数模型在摄像头一致性和动态一致性方面得分更高，但仍难以准确再现动作时机、接触关系以及主体间的协同运动。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: (1) We introduce CineRecon, a benchmark comprising 50 reference videos and 360 annotated evaluation clips for evaluating agents that reconstruct complete dynamic videos as editable Blender scenes. (2) We define three representation settings and evaluate camera, static, and dynamic consistency using evaluation clips and checklists that have undergone multiple rounds of human review and refinement. (3) We analyze how 12 multimodal coding models perform with their corresponding agent harnesses and identify shared deficits in spatial relations, specific action events, and camera changes. Cross-setting comparisons further show that simplifying appearance requirements improves performance for most models, while substantial errors in action timing, contact relations, and coordinated subject motion persist under Proxy.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献有三方面：(1) 我们提出了 CineRecon，这是一个基准数据集，包含 50 条参考视频和 360 个带标注的评估片段，用于评估能够重建完整动态视频为可编辑 Blender 场景的智能体。 (2) 我们定义了三种表示设置，并使用经过多轮人工审核与优化的评估片段和检查清单，对相机一致性、静态一致性和动态一致性进行了评估。 (3) 我们分析了 12 种多模态编码模型与其对应的智能体工具集的表现，并识别出它们在空间关系、特定动作事件和相机变化方面存在的共同缺陷。 跨设置比较进一步表明，简化外观要求能够提升大多数模型的性能，但在 Proxy 设置下，动作时机、接触关系和主体协同运动方面的显著错误仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: Figure illustrates this reconstruction workflow, with aligned reference and rendered frames and the resulting editable scene. The agent inspects the reference, constructs and animates the scene, and uses rendered feedback to revise its reconstruction. It receives generic task instructions, but no video-specific annotations, reference camera parameters, or evaluation checklists. paragraphs.zh: 该图展示了这一重建工作流程，包括对齐的参考帧和渲染帧，以及最终生成的可编辑场景。 智能体会检查参考帧、构建并动画化场景，然后利用渲染反馈来修正其重建结果。 它接收通用的任务指令，但不会获得任何与视频相关的注释、参考相机参数或评估清单。 主要协议禁止使用外部资源、资源生成服务，以及将参考图像用作背景或投影表面以替代三维建模。 我们通过比较重建场景的渲染视频与参考视频中可见的内容来评估重建结果。

paragraphs.en: The three settings increase geometric and appearance requirements while preserving requirements for spatial relations, camera behavior, motion, interactions, and event timing (Figure 4 ). Each setting specifies the geometric and appearance features that the output should preserve.
paragraphs.zh: 这三种设置提高了几何和外观方面的要求，同时保留了空间关系、相机行为、运动、交互和事件时间方面的要求（图 4）。 每种设置都指定了输出需要保留的几何和外观特征。

paragraphs.en: Subjects can be represented by a small number of geometric primitives or simple combinations. The construction must preserve subject counts, coarse proportions, and the movable parts needed to express the observed actions. Category-specific shapes, colors, clothing, materials, textures, and decorations are not required. For articulated motion, the proxy must contain suitable moving parts when a rigid object would be unable to reproduce the action.
paragraphs.zh: 主体可以用少量几何基本体或简单的组合来表示。 构建过程必须保留主体的数量、大致比例以及表达所观察动作所需的可移动部分。 无需使用特定类别的形状、颜色、服装、材料、纹理和装饰。 对于关节运动，当刚性物体无法再现该动作时，代理必须包含合适的可移动部分。

sents.zh: 对于关节运动，当刚性物体无法再现该动作时，代理必须包含合适的可移动部分。

paragraphs.en: Subjects must have recognizable categories, overall silhouettes, and major structural components. Proportions and salient appearance features should broadly match the reference. Small textures, ornaments, and other fine details may be simplified.
paragraphs.zh: 主体必须具有可识别的类别、整体轮廓和主要结构部件。 比例和显著外观特征应与参考对象大致一致。 小型纹理、装饰和其他精细细节可以简化处理。

paragraphs.en: Subjects must reproduce the visible structure and appearance of the specific reference instances, including distinctive local shapes, clearly visible parts, and fine appearance features.
paragraphs.zh: 受试者必须复现特定参考实例的可见结构和外观，包括独特的局部形状、清晰可见的部分以及精细的外观特征。

paragraphs.en: CineRecon contains 50 reference videos, including film footage, sports and first-person recordings, aerial footage, gameplay, and racing. The collection includes both captured and rendered content, with subject motions and interactions, camera movement, changing viewpoints, and shot transitions. Each complete video is a reconstruction input. Temporal annotations are used only for evaluation. Figure 5 illustrates the reference sequences and distributions of annotated subject counts and video duration. Aggregated by reference video, the annotations record camera motion in 94% of videos, subject interaction in 58%, and shot transitions in 18%.
paragraphs.zh: CineRecon 包含 50 段参考视频，涵盖电影片段、体育和第一人称录像、航拍画面、游戏过程以及赛车内容。 该合集既包括拍摄内容，也包括渲染内容，其中包含主体动作与互动、相机移动、视角变化以及镜头转换。 每段完整视频都是一次重建输入。 时间标注仅用于评估。 图 5 展示了参考序列以及标注主体数量和视频时长的分布情况。 按参考视频汇总的标注数据显示：94% 的视频记录了相机运动，58% 记录了主体互动，18% 记录了镜头转换。

sents.zh: 图 5 展示了参考序列以及标注主体数量和视频时长的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: We annotate 360 evaluation clips from the 50 reference videos and construct a structured checklist for each clip. An evaluation clip spans a contiguous interval of at most two seconds and captures a salient scene state, camera change, subject motion, or interaction. Clips may overlap and may cross shot boundaries. All evaluation clips and checklist statements were initially annotated by Codex powered by GPT-6 Astra, followed by multiple rounds of human review and refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 50 段参考视频中标注了 360 个评估片段，并为每个片段构建了一个结构化检查清单。 一个评估片段覆盖最多两秒的连续时间区间，并捕捉到显著的场景状态、镜头切换、主体运动或互动。 这些片段可能相互重叠，也可能跨越镜头边界。 所有评估片段和检查清单条目最初都由 Codex（基于 GPT-6 Astra）标注，随后经过多轮人工审核与优化。

sents.en: We annotate 360 evaluation clips from the 50 reference videos and construct a structured checklist for each clip.
sents.zh: 我们从 50 段参考视频中标注了 360 个评估片段，并为每个片段构建了一个结构化检查清单。

sents.en: An evaluation clip spans a contiguous interval of at most two seconds and captures a salient scene state, camera change, subject motion, or interaction.
sents.zh: 一个评估片段覆盖最多两秒的连续时间区间，并捕捉到显著的场景状态、镜头切换、主体运动或互动。

sents.en: Clips may overlap and may cross shot boundaries.
sents.zh: 这些片段可能相互重叠，也可能跨越镜头边界。

sents.en: All evaluation clips and checklist statements were initially annotated by Codex powered by GPT-6 Astra, followed by multiple rounds of human review and refinement.
sents.zh: 所有评估片段和检查清单条目最初都由 Codex（基于 GPT-6 Astra）标注，随后经过多轮人工审核与优化。

paragraphs.en: Within each clip, each checklist statement associates an observable property or event with an identifiable entity and a specified timestamp or interval. The annotations cover 11 categories across camera, static, and dynamic consistency. Applicable statements are adapted to the representation setting. Detailed dataset statistics are provided in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在每个片段中，每个检查清单陈述都将一个可观察的属性或事件与一个可识别的实体以及指定的时间戳或时间间隔关联起来。 这些标注涵盖了摄像头、静态一致性和动态一致性方面的 11 个类别。 适用的陈述会根据表示设置进行调整。 详细的数据集统计信息见附录 A.1。

sents.en: Within each clip, each checklist statement associates an observable property or event with an identifiable entity and a specified timestamp or interval.
sents.zh: 在每个片段中，每个检查清单陈述都将一个可观察的属性或事件与一个可识别的实体以及指定的时间戳或时间间隔关联起来。

sents.en: The annotations cover 11 categories across camera, static, and dynamic consistency.
sents.zh: 这些标注涵盖了摄像头、静态一致性和动态一致性方面的 11 个类别。

sents.en: Applicable statements are adapted to the representation setting.
sents.zh: 适用的陈述会根据表示设置进行调整。

sents.zh: 详细的数据集统计信息见附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the rendered reconstruction against its reference video using the annotated checklists. A vision-language judge compares reference and rendered frames at aligned timestamps and assesses the applicable statements under the prescribed representation setting. The 11 checklist categories are organized into three consistency dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用已标注的检查清单，将渲染后的重建结果与其参考视频进行对比评估。 视觉-语言判判器在对应的时间戳上比较参考帧与渲染帧，并根据规定的表示设置评估适用的陈述。 这 11 个检查清单类别被组织为三个一致性维度。

sents.en: We evaluate the rendered reconstruction against its reference video using the annotated checklists.
sents.zh: 我们使用已标注的检查清单，将渲染后的重建结果与其参考视频进行对比评估。

sents.en: A vision-language judge compares reference and rendered frames at aligned timestamps and assesses the applicable statements under the prescribed representation setting.
sents.zh: 视觉-语言判判器在对应的时间戳上比较参考帧与渲染帧，并根据规定的表示设置评估适用的陈述。

sents.en: The 11 checklist categories are organized into three consistency dimensions.
sents.zh: 这 11 个检查清单类别被组织为三个一致性维度。

paragraphs.en: Camera Consistency covers six categories: translation , the direction of camera displacement relative to its orientation at the start of the checked interval; rotation , changes in pan, tilt, and roll; zoom , visible zoom-in or zoom-out effects associated with changes in field of view; position , the camera’s location relative to scene landmarks at a specified frame; target , the subject or region toward which the camera points at that frame; and shot transitions , the number of shot transitions within the clip. Translation, rotation, and zoom are checked over intervals within a shot. Position and target describe the viewpoint at individual timestamps.
paragraphs.zh: 相机一致性涵盖六个类别：平移，即相机在检查区间开始时相对于其初始朝向的位移方向；旋转，即俯仰、倾斜和滚动的变化；变焦，即与视场变化相关的可见变焦拉近或推远效果；位置，即相机在指定帧中相对于场景地标的位置；目标，即相机在该帧所指向的主体或区域；以及镜头转换，即片段内的镜头转换次数。 平移、旋转和变焦是在单个镜头内的区间进行检查的。 位置和目标是用于描述特定时间戳处视角的要素。

sents.en: Camera Consistency covers six categories: translation , the direction of camera displacement relative to its orientation at the start of the checked interval; rotation , changes in pan, tilt, and roll; zoom , visible zoom-in or zoom-out effects associated with changes in field of view; position , the camera’s location relative to scene landmarks at a specified frame; target , the subject or region toward which the camera points at that frame; and shot transitions , the number of shot transitions within the clip.
sents.zh: 相机一致性涵盖六个类别：平移，即相机在检查区间开始时相对于其初始朝向的位移方向；旋转，即俯仰、倾斜和滚动的变化；变焦，即与视场变化相关的可见变焦拉近或推远效果；位置，即相机在指定帧中相对于场景地标的位置；目标，即相机在该帧所指向的主体或区域；以及镜头转换，即片段内的镜头转换次数。

sents.en: Translation, rotation, and zoom are checked over intervals within a shot.
sents.zh: 平移、旋转和变焦是在单个镜头内的区间进行检查的。

sents.en: Position and target describe the viewpoint at individual timestamps.
sents.zh: 位置和目标是用于描述特定时间戳处视角的要素。

paragraphs.en: Static Consistency covers three categories at specified frames: object presence , whether the required entities or scene regions are visible in the correct numbers; object appearance , whether their shape, color, material, and visible details meet the representation requirements; and spatial relations , whether relative positions, orientations, occlusions, and support or contact relationships are reproduced. Appearance checks apply to Simplified and Detailed, with detail requirements defined by the setting.
paragraphs.zh: 静态一致性涵盖指定帧中的三类内容：对象存在性，即所需实体或场景区域是否以正确的数量可见；对象外观，即其形状、颜色、材质和可见细节是否符合表现要求；以及空间关系，即相对位置、朝向、遮挡以及支撑或接触关系是否被准确再现。 外观检查适用于简化版和详细版，其中细节要求由设置定义。

sents.en: Static Consistency covers three categories at specified frames: object presence , whether the required entities or scene regions are visible in the correct numbers; object appearance , whether their shape, color, material, and visible details meet the representation requirements; and spatial relations , whether relative positions, orientations, occlusions, and support or contact relationships are reproduced.
sents.zh: 静态一致性涵盖指定帧中的三类内容：对象存在性，即所需实体或场景区域是否以正确的数量可见；对象外观，即其形状、颜色、材质和可见细节是否符合表现要求；以及空间关系，即相对位置、朝向、遮挡以及支撑或接触关系是否被准确再现。

sents.en: Appearance checks apply to Simplified and Detailed, with detail requirements defined by the setting.
sents.zh: 外观检查适用于简化版和详细版，其中细节要求由设置定义。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic Consistency covers two categories: subject motion , the direction and path of overall displacement relative to a specified reference, including approaching, receding, and entering or leaving view; and action events , events beyond whole-subject displacement within a specified time interval, such as arm raising, grasping, opening or closing, as well as interactions, deformation, and state changes.
paragraphs.zh: 动态一致性涵盖两类内容：主体运动，即相对于指定参考点的整体位移方向和路径，包括靠近、远离以及进入或离开视野；以及动作事件，即在指定时间间隔内超出主体整体位移范围的事件，例如抬手、抓取、打开或关闭，以及相互作用、形变和状态变化。

paragraphs.en: For each dimension, we average check-item scores within each clip and then average across clips with equal weight. The overall score is the arithmetic mean of the three dimension scores. Since check-item counts differ substantially across dimensions, equal weighting prevents dimensions with more annotations from dominating the overall score. The score measures agreement with the reference in the rendered evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个维度，我们先对每个片段内的检查项得分求平均，然后以相等的权重对所有片段的平均值进行平均。 总得分是三个维度得分的算术平均值。 由于不同维度的检查项数量存在显著差异，采用等权重可以避免标注较多的维度在总得分中占据主导地位。 该得分衡量的是渲染出的证据与参考答案之间的一致性。

sents.en: For each dimension, we average check-item scores within each clip and then average across clips with equal weight.
sents.zh: 对于每个维度，我们先对每个片段内的检查项得分求平均，然后以相等的权重对所有片段的平均值进行平均。

sents.en: The overall score is the arithmetic mean of the three dimension scores.
sents.zh: 总得分是三个维度得分的算术平均值。

sents.zh: 该得分衡量的是渲染出的证据与参考答案之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 12 multimodal coding models: GPT-6 Astra [ 35 ] , GPT-5.6 Sol [ 34 ] , Claude Opus 5.5 [ 5 ] , Claude Opus 4.8 [ 4 ] , Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 13 ] , Gemini 3.8 Flash [ 14 ] , Qwen3.8-Max [ 3 ] , Qwen3.8-Flash [ 2 ] , Kimi K3 [ 33 ] , Grok 4.6 [ 37 ] , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 9 ] , and GLM-5.3-Flash [ 41 ] . Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-Flash use xhigh reasoning effort. The other ten models use high. We additionally include Opus 5.5 at low effort, giving 13 configurations in the quantitative comparisons. Model names without an effort label refer to the configurations listed above. Opus 5.5 (Low) denotes the low-effort configuration. paragraphs.en: Multimodal evaluators assess instruction adherence in image synthesis [ 23 ] and predict multidimensional human ratings of generated videos [ 18 ] . We use GPT-5.6 Sol [ 34 ] with high reasoning effort as the VLM judge. Each request evaluates one reconstructed clip under one representation setting, using timestamp-aligned reference and rendered frames, the reference entity table, and the applicable checklist. Frames cover annotated observations, event intervals, and shot transitions. The judge rates each item as unsatisfied, partially satisfied, or fully satisfied, mapped to 0, 0.5, and 1. We aggregate scores over the 360 annotated clips following Sec. 2.4 and report camera, static, dynamic, and overall scores on a 0–100 scale. Appendix C specifies frame selection, judging instructions, and score aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态评估器用于评估图像合成对指令的遵循程度 [23]，并预测生成视频的多维度人类评分 [18]。 我们使用具备高推理能力的 GPT-5.6 Sol [34] 作为 VLM 评判者。 每次请求均针对一个重建片段，在一种表示设置下进行评估，并使用时间戳对齐的参考素材与渲染帧、参考实体表以及适用的检查清单。 这些帧涵盖了带标注的观察内容、事件区间和镜头转换。 评判者对每个项目评定为“未满足”“部分满足”或“完全满足”，分别对应分数 0、0.5 和 1。 我们按照第 2.4 节的流程，对 360 个带标注的片段进行评分汇总，并以 0–100 的尺度报告摄像头、静态、动态及总体得分。 附录 C 详细说明了帧的选择、评判指令以及分数汇总方法。

paragraphs.en: We assess alignment with human judgments through dimension-specific pairwise preferences. The study comprises 1,440 comparisons across 12 models, with 480 each for camera, static, and dynamic consistency. Model reasoning settings follow Table 4 . Each task presents a reference clip or frame and two anonymized reconstructions under the same representation setting. Raters select the result that better matches the reference on the specified dimension or indicate no clear difference. Human and automatic win rates use the same comparisons, count ties as half a win, and weight the three settings equally within each dimension. The overall win rate averages the three dimensions equally. Sampling, annotation, and preference aggregation are detailed in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过特定维度的成对偏好来评估与人类判断的一致性。 该研究包含 12 个模型之间的 1,440 次比较，其中相机一致性、静态一致性和动态一致性各占 480 次。 模型推理设置遵循表 4。 每个任务都会提供一个参考片段或帧，以及在同一表示设置下的两个匿名重建结果。 评估者需选择与参考在指定维度上更匹配的结果，或指出无明显差异。 人类和自动评估的胜率使用相同的比较数据，将平局计为半个胜利，并在每个维度内对三种设置给予同等权重。 总体胜率是对三个维度的等权平均。 采样、标注和偏好聚合的详细信息见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Existing models share relative weaknesses in specific actions, spatial relations, and camera changes. Across all three settings, each of the 13 configurations scores higher on subject motion than action events, object presence than spatial relations, and camera targets than rotation. Figure 2 presents category scores averaged across representation settings. Scores average items within each clip and category, then weight clips equally for each configuration. The highest model scores on action events are only 42.7, 46.6, and 48.6 in Proxy, Simplified, and Detailed, respectively, indicating that even stronger models incompletely reproduce specific actions and interactions. Category score gaps appear in Appendix 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 现有模型在特定动作、空间关系和摄像头变化方面存在相对弱点。 在所有三种设置中，13 种配置中的每一种在主体运动方面的得分均高于动作事件，在物体存在方面的得分均高于空间关系，在摄像头目标方面的得分均高于旋转。 图 2 展示了各表示设置下的平均类别得分。 得分是对每个剪辑和类别中各项的平均值，然后对每种配置中的剪辑进行等权重计算。 模型在动作事件上的最高得分在 Proxy、Simplified 和 Detailed 设置中分别为 42.7、46.6 和 48.6，这表明即使更强大的模型也无法完整再现特定动作和交互。 类别得分的差异见附录 8。

paragraphs.en: Language models infer structured scene representations from images [ 24 ] , while graphics agents edit and reconstruct Blender scenes through visual feedback [ 21 , 16 , 40 ] . Code-based generation also supports dynamic scenes from text [ 42 , 28 ] . IR3D-Bench [ 29 ] evaluates scene reconstruction from images, while 3DCodeBench [ 12 ] evaluates procedural object modeling from text and image references. For video reconstruction, BVB [ 38 ] focuses on indoor scenes with moving cameras, while 4DCodeBench [ 36 ] studies physical dynamics in real and synthetic videos with minimal camera motion. SceneActBench supplies assets and a reference camera for synthetic dynamic reconstruction [ 43 ] . VisPhyWorld uses two keyframes from synthetic physical scenes under fixed camera configurations [ 25 ] . CineRecon targets filmmaking, evaluating joint reconstruction of scene content, subject actions and interactions, camera movements, and shot transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型从图像中推断出结构化的场景表示 [ 24 ]，而图形智能体则通过视觉反馈编辑和重建 Blender 场景 [ 21 , 16 , 40 ]。 基于代码的生成方法也支持从文本中构建动态场景 [ 42 , 28 ]。 IR3D-Bench [ 29 ] 评估从图像进行场景重建的能力，而 3DCodeBench [ 12 ] 则评估根据文本和图像参考进行程序化对象建模的能力。 在视频重建方面，BVB [ 38 ] 专注于包含移动摄像机的室内场景，而 4DCodeBench [ 36 ] 研究具有最小相机运动的真实和合成视频中的物理动态。 SceneActBench 提供资产和参考摄像机，用于合成动态场景的重建 [ 43 ]。 VisPhyWorld 使用固定相机配置下合成物理场景的两个关键帧 [ 25 ]。 CineRecon 针对电影制作，评估场景内容、主体动作与交互、摄像机运动以及镜头转换的联合重建能力。

paragraphs.en: CineRecon benchmarks reconstruction of dynamic cinematic videos as editable Blender scenes through camera, static, and dynamic checks under three representation settings. We evaluate 12 multimodal coding models using their native agent harnesses. Our analysis identifies spatial relations, specific action events, and camera changes as shared weaknesses of these models. Simplifying appearance requirements improves camera and dynamic consistency for most models, yet errors in action timing, contact relations, and coordinated subject motion persist under Proxy. These findings make the joint reconstruction of geometry, actions, and camera behavior a priority for graphics agents. CineRecon provides a basis for measuring progress toward editable visual proxies for controllable video generation. Evaluating their effect on downstream generation is a next step.
paragraphs.zh: CineRecon 基准通过相机、静态和动态检查，在三种表示设置下，将动态电影视频的重建结果转化为可编辑的 Blender 场景。 我们使用 12 种多模态编码模型的原生智能体工具包对其进行了评估。 我们的分析发现，空间关系、特定动作事件和相机变化是这些模型的共同弱点。 简化外观要求能够提升大多数模型的相机一致性和动态一致性，但在 Proxy 设置下，动作时机、接触关系和主体协同运动方面的错误仍然存在。 这些研究结果表明，几何结构、动作和相机行为的联合重建应成为图形智能体的优先任务。 CineRecon 为衡量在生成可控视频方面实现可编辑视觉代理的进展提供了基准。 评估它们对下游生成任务的影响是下一步的工作。

paragraphs.en: Proxy, Simplified, and Detailed contain 9,647, 20,021, and 20,000 checks, respectively, totaling 49,668 setting-specific checks. paragraphs.en: We organize reconstruction tasks by complete reference video and annotate local clips for evaluation. Clips cover observable scene states, subject actions and interactions, camera changes, and shot transitions. They may overlap or cross shot boundaries. All clips and check items were initially annotated by Codex powered by GPT-6 Astra, followed by multiple rounds of human review and refinement. Review used reference frames and temporal sequences to check subject correspondence, visible facts, temporal ranges, categories, and applicable representation settings, and to revise statements inconsistent with or insufficiently supported by the visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照完整的参考视频组织重建任务，并为评估标注局部片段。 这些片段涵盖了可观察的场景状态、主体动作与互动、镜头变化以及镜头转换。 它们可能重叠或跨越镜头边界。 所有片段和检查项最初都由 Codex（基于 GPT-6 Astra）进行标注，随后经过多轮人工审核与优化。 审核过程中参考了关键帧和时间序列，以验证主体对应关系、可见事实、时间范围、类别以及适用的表示设置，并修正与视觉证据不符或支持不足的说法。

sents.zh: 这些片段涵盖了可观察的场景状态、主体动作与互动、镜头变化以及镜头转换。

sents.zh: 审核过程中参考了关键帧和时间序列，以验证主体对应关系、可见事实、时间范围、类别以及适用的表示设置，并修正与视觉证据不符或支持不足的说法。

paragraphs.en: Each check item records its category, applicable settings, referenced subjects, local start and end frames, and an assessable requirement. Frame-specific checks describe visible states, such as subject counts, relative positions, or hand-ground contact. Interval checks describe temporal changes, such as camera translation, subject trajectories, or a crouching action. Items are organized into the eleven categories defined in the main text, separating camera behavior, static states, and dynamic processes. Action and interaction statements specify observable progression and timing. Appearance statements concern structures and attributes supported by the frames.
paragraphs.zh: 每个检查项都记录其类别、适用设置、参考主体、本地起始和结束帧，以及一个可评估的要求。 特定帧的检查描述了可见状态，例如主体数量、相对位置或手与地面的接触。 区间检查描述了时间上的变化，例如相机平移、主体轨迹或蹲下动作。 各项内容按照主文中定义的十一类进行组织，分别涵盖相机行为、静态状态和动态过程。 动作与交互陈述明确了可观察的进展和时序。 外观陈述涉及帧所支持的结构和属性。

paragraphs.en: Representation settings determine the granularity of appearance checks. Proxy assesses object presence, spatial relations, camera behavior, and dynamics. Simplified appearance checks require recognizable categories, overall silhouettes, major structures, and salient attributes. Detailed additionally requires visible local structures and details of the reference instance. Camera and dynamic checks retain the same categories, subjects, and temporal intervals across settings, supporting comparisons of these capabilities as appearance requirements are reduced.
paragraphs.zh: 表示设置决定了外观检查的粒度。 代理会评估对象是否存在、空间关系、摄像头行为以及动态变化。 简化的外观检查需要可识别的类别、整体轮廓、主要结构和显著属性。 详细的检查则还需要参考实例中可见的局部结构和细节。 无论设置如何，摄像头和动态检查都保留相同的类别、对象和时间间隔，从而可以在降低外观要求时比较这些能力。

paragraphs.en: Entity tables assign fixed names to individually tracked people, animals, and vehicles, such as Person A, Person B, and Vehicle A. Interaction objects may also receive identifiers when similar objects need to be distinguished. Scene regions such as ground and grass retain descriptive names. Group entries specify their scope to avoid counting individually identified members twice. Subjects with established correspondence retain stable identifiers within a source video, and the three settings share the same entity table for each clip. Subsequent checks use these fixed names, with appearance attributes stated as separate requirements in the applicable items.
paragraphs.zh: 实体表为单独追踪的人、动物和车辆分配固定名称，例如“人 A”、“人 B”和“车辆 A”。 当需要区分相似对象时，交互对象也可能获得标识符。 地面和草地等场景区域保留描述性名称。 组条目会明确其范围，以避免将单独识别的成员重复计数。 已建立对应关系的主题在源视频中保留稳定的标识符，且三种设置对每个片段共享相同的实体表。 后续检查使用这些固定名称，外观属性则在适用条目中作为独立要求列出。

paragraphs.en: Each numbered subject has a short identifying description and a first-appearance frame. First appearance denotes the earliest identifiable visible part that can be linked to the subject through the temporal sequence. Color and clothing descriptions in the entity table locate the reference subject, while check statements and their applicable settings define the scoring requirements. Local frame indices start at zero, and temporal intervals include both endpoints. The released records also store the clip’s frame offset in the source video, mapping local annotations to the complete reference. Spatial statements specify image directions or relative reference objects, and subject correspondence remains consistent throughout each annotated motion or interaction interval.
paragraphs.zh: 每个编号主体都有一段简短的识别性描述和一个首次出现帧。 首次出现指的是最早可被识别且能通过时间序列与该主体关联的可见部分。 实体表中的颜色和服装描述用于定位参考主体，而检查语句及其适用设置则定义了评分要求。 局部帧索引从零开始，时间区间包含两个端点。 已发布的记录还存储了片段在源视频中的帧偏移量，从而将局部标注映射到完整的参考内容。 空间陈述指明了图像方向或相对参考对象，且主体对应关系在整个标注的运动或交互区间内保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 presents eight Simplified checks and their VLM judge ratings. The presence of both subjects, Person B’s main clothing, the initial spatial configuration, and the fixed-camera requirements are rated fully satisfied. The final hand-support relation and the action requirement to establish and maintain support after crouching are rated unsatisfied. paragraphs.en: Each reconstruction task supplies the complete reference video, a representation-specific instruction, and an output directory. The agent selects the frames and temporal intervals used for its own analysis and verification. Evaluation clips, entity tables, checklists, and reference camera parameters are withheld. The following summarizes the shared instructions and setting-specific requirements of the task prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 每个重建任务都会提供完整的参考视频、一个与表示方法相关的指令以及一个输出目录。 智能体会自行选择用于分析和验证的帧和时序区间。 评估片段、实体表、检查清单和参考相机参数均不予提供。 以下内容总结了任务提示中通用的指令和特定设置的要求。

sents.zh: 每个重建任务都会提供完整的参考视频、一个与表示方法相关的指令以及一个输出目录。

sents.en: The following summarizes the shared instructions and setting-specific requirements of the task prompts.

paragraphs.en: The requested deliverables are scene.blend , reconstruction.mp4 , a synchronized side-by-side comparison video, a comparison contact sheet, and a short implementation and verification report. Reference footage appears on the left and reconstruction on the right in the comparison. Each rendered frame must correspond to the same time in the reference. Temporal shifts, speed changes, interpolation, and repeated frames must not conceal reconstruction errors.
paragraphs.zh: 所需的交付成果包括 scene.blend、reconstruction.mp4、一段同步的并排对比视频、一张对比接页，以及一份简短的实现与验证报告。 在对比中，参考视频出现在左侧，重建结果出现在右侧。 每一帧渲染出的画面都必须与参考视频中同一时刻的画面对应。 时间偏移、速度变化、插值以及重复的帧不得掩盖重建错误。

paragraphs.en: The reconstruction environment uses Blender 5.2 [ 7 ] with Blender MCP [ 1 ] , alongside the file, shell, and media-inspection tools provided by each agent harness. Blender MCP exposes scene inspection, Python execution within Blender, and viewport capture. The agent can construct geometry and materials, configure lights and cameras, animate objects and articulated parts, inspect scene state, and save the editable project. Local Python utilities and FFmpeg/FFprobe support frame extraction, image comparison, video encoding, and checks of the output timeline. The agent determines its analysis frames, scene parameterization, animation implementation, and intermediate render settings.
paragraphs.zh: 重建环境使用 Blender 5.2 [ 7 ] 和 Blender MCP [ 1 ]，并结合各智能体框架提供的文件、外壳和媒体检查工具。 Blender MCP 支持场景检查、在 Blender 内部执行 Python 脚本以及视口捕获功能。 该智能体能够构建几何体和材质，配置灯光和相机，为物体和可活动部件制作动画，检查场景状态，并保存可编辑的项目文件。 本地 Python 工具以及 FFmpeg/FFprobe 支持帧提取、图像比较、视频编码以及对输出时间线的检查。 该智能体负责确定分析帧、场景参数化、动画实现以及中间渲染设置。

paragraphs.en: Frame selection preserves the evidence needed by the checklist. Mandatory frames include the first and last frames of the clip, the annotated evidence frames and endpoints of each applicable check, and the frames immediately before, at, and after each annotated shot transition, where these fall within the clip. Additional candidates include interval midpoints, annotation-specified sample frames, and samples at approximately eight frames per second. A request contains at most 50 aligned frame pairs. When the candidate set exceeds this limit, all mandatory frames are retained. The remaining slots are filled by successively choosing the candidate farthest from the selected frames, with earlier frames breaking ties. This maintains coverage between the required observations. The released annotations fit within this limit for all three settings.

paragraphs.en: Subject names and identification descriptions establish which reference entity a check concerns. The judge maintains the same reference-to-reconstruction correspondence across the checks and must not exchange subjects to satisfy individual relations. Group members are not counted again as independent instances, and mirror reflections are not counted as additional people. A missing subject or reference object required by a relation makes that relation unsatisfied. Checks that explicitly describe occlusion or leaving the frame are assessed according to their stated conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 主体名称和身份描述用于确定某项检查涉及的是哪个参考实体。 裁判必须在所有检查中保持参考实体与重建结果之间的一致性，且不得为满足个别关系而更换主体。 群体成员不会被重复计为独立个体，镜像反射也不会被计为额外人物。 若某个关系所需的主体或参考对象缺失，则该关系被视为未满足。 明确描述了遮挡或离开画面的检查，将依据其所述条件进行评估。

paragraphs.en: The setting-specific instructions define which appearance properties enter the judgment. Under Proxy, simple distinguishable geometric stand-ins are allowed. Reference names and appearance descriptions serve as identity cues, and category-specific shape, color, clothing, material, texture, and decoration are not appearance requirements. Object presence, count, spatial relations, camera behavior, motion, and interaction remain subject to the checklist. Under Simplified, appearance checks require recognizable categories, silhouettes, proportions, important components, and the salient colors, patterns, clothing or structures, and material categories explicitly stated in the item. Detailed additionally checks clearly visible local features and reference-specific appearance. Across settings, presence, relation, camera, and dynamic checks are judged by their own statements without adding independent appearance conditions. Allowed simplifications incur no penalty, and neither pixel equality nor unspecified invisible details is required.

paragraphs.en: Before accepting a judgment, the pipeline verifies that the response is complete, contains the expected JSON fields, and returns exactly one permitted label for every input item. Truncated responses, refusals, invalid labels, and missing or extra ratings are recorded as evaluation failures. Recoverable request failures, including timeouts and rate limits, trigger retries with the same evidence and checklist. A score is attached only after the response passes these checks. The saved record links each item to its label, numerical score, input evidence, and judge configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 在接受判断之前，该流程会验证响应是否完整、是否包含预期的 JSON 字段，并且对每个输入项都返回且仅返回一个允许的标签。 截断的响应、拒绝、无效的标签以及缺失或多余的评分均被记录为评估失败。 可恢复的请求失败（包括超时和速率限制）会触发使用相同证据和检查清单的重试。 只有在响应通过这些检查之后，才会附加分数。 保存的记录会将每个项与其标签、数值分数、输入证据和判断配置关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Human evaluation uses dimension-specific pairwise comparisons to assess whether relative model performance under automatic evaluation agrees with human preferences. Each task presents a reference clip, reconstructions from two models under the same representation setting, and one evaluation dimension. The study contains 1,440 tasks covering 50 reference videos and 12 models, with 480 tasks each for camera, static, and dynamic consistency. Reasoning settings follow Table 4 . Table 6 summarizes the allocation across representation settings. Comparisons of the same reconstruction pair on different dimensions count as separate tasks.

paragraphs.en: Sampling uses exposure counts for videos, settings, models, and model pairs. Score magnitudes and differences do not enter selection. Camera and static comparisons each cover all 50 videos, with nine or ten tasks per video. Dynamic comparisons draw from the 47 videos with applicable dynamic checks, with nine to eleven tasks per video. Within each dimension, each model appears 79–81 times, and each of the 66 unordered model pairs appears seven or eight times. This allocation provides similar exposure across videos, models, and opponents.

paragraphs.en: Camera and dynamic consistency are judged from temporally aligned reference and reconstruction clips. Static consistency is judged from reference and reconstructed frames at times specified by applicable checks. The candidates are anonymized as A and B. Raters receive the current dimension and representation requirements, while model names, execution configurations, and automatic scores are withheld. Task order is independently randomized for each rater, and assignment to A or B is balanced within each dimension.

paragraphs.en: Raters compare fidelity to the reference along the specified dimension. Camera judgments concern viewpoint, framing, camera motion, and shot transitions. Static judgments concern object presence, structure, appearance, and spatial relations. Dynamic judgments concern motion directions and paths, specific actions, interactions, and their timing. Representation requirements follow the main protocol: Proxy permits geometric stand-ins, Simplified requires recognizable structures and salient appearance, and Detailed requires reference-specific visible details. All settings retain the corresponding spatial, camera, and dynamic requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 评分者沿指定维度比较与参考内容的忠实度。 相机相关判断涉及视角、构图、相机运动和镜头转换。 静态判断涉及物体存在、结构、外观和空间关系。 动态判断涉及运动方向和路径、具体动作、互动及其时间顺序。 表现要求遵循主协议：Proxy 允许使用几何替代物，Simplified 要求具有可识别的结构和显著外观，而 Detailed 则要求包含参考内容特有的可见细节。 所有设置均保留相应的空间、相机和动态要求。

paragraphs.en: Three raters independently assess all 1,440 comparison tasks. For each task, they choose whether A better matches the reference, the two results show no clear difference, or B better matches the reference. They cannot see one another’s labels before submitting. No clear difference denotes similar reconstruction quality on the specified dimension. Tasks with playback failures, insufficient evidence, or inapplicable dimensions are recorded as issues with an explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 三名评分员独立评估全部 1,440 项比较任务。 对于每项任务，他们需要选择 A 与参考结果更匹配、两项结果无明显差异，还是 B 与参考结果更匹配。 在提交之前，他们无法看到彼此的标签。 “无明显差异”表示在指定维度上的重建质量相似。 播放失败、证据不足或维度不适用的任务会被记录为问题，并附上说明。

sents.en: For each task, they choose whether A better matches the reference, the two results show no clear difference, or B better matches the reference.
sents.zh: 对于每项任务，他们需要选择 A 与参考结果更匹配、两项结果无明显差异，还是 B 与参考结果更匹配。

sents.en: They cannot see one another’s labels before submitting.
sents.zh: 在提交之前，他们无法看到彼此的标签。

sents.en: No clear difference denotes similar reconstruction quality on the specified dimension.
sents.zh: “无明显差异”表示在指定维度上的重建质量相似。

sents.en: Tasks with playback failures, insufficient evidence, or inapplicable dimensions are recorded as issues with an explanation.
sents.zh: 播放失败、证据不足或维度不适用的任务会被记录为问题，并附上说明。

paragraphs.en: Preferences are aggregated by majority vote: an option selected by at least two of the three raters becomes the task label. Tasks with an issue report or three different votes are excluded from both human and automatic aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 偏好通过多数投票进行汇总：至少两名评审员选择的选项将成为任务标签。 存在问题报告或出现三种不同投票的任务，将同时排除在人工和自动汇总之外。

paragraphs.en: Human preferences and automatic scores are both converted into pairwise win, tie, and loss scores. For the aggregated human preference, a win earns 1, a loss earns 0, and a tie earns 0.5 for each model. Automatic comparison uses the two models’ scores for the same dimension, clip, and representation setting. The higher score earns 1 and the lower score earns 0. Exact equality of the original scores yields 0.5 for each model. Both sides compute win rates on the same tasks with valid preference labels.
paragraphs.zh: 人类偏好和自动评分都会被转换为成对的胜、平、负得分。 对于汇总后的人类偏好，每款模型获胜得 1 分，失败得 0 分，打平则各得 0.5 分。 自动比较使用两款模型在同一维度、剪辑和表示设置下的评分。 分数较高的模型得 1 分，较低的模型得 0 分。 若原始评分完全相等，则每款模型各得 0.5 分。 双方均在具有有效偏好标签的相同任务上计算胜率。

paragraphs.en: For the overall result and each dimension, agreement across the 12 models is measured with Spearman correlation between human and automatic win rates. Pearson correlation additionally describes their numerical relationship. Each point in the corresponding scatter plot represents one model, with human win rate on the horizontal axis and automatic win rate on the vertical axis. This analysis assesses alignment with human judgments at the level of relative model performance.
paragraphs.zh: 对于整体结果和每个维度，12 个模型之间的一致性通过人类与自动胜率之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数进行衡量。 皮尔逊相关系数进一步描述了它们之间的数值关系。 在相应的散点图中，每个点代表一个模型，横轴为人类胜率，纵轴为自动胜率。 这项分析评估了模型相对性能层面与人类判断的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Of the 1,440 comparison tasks, 1,360 yield valid preference labels: 448 for camera consistency and 456 each for static and dynamic consistency. The excluded tasks comprise 19 issue reports and 61 three-way splits. Table 7 reports the resulting model-level correlations.
paragraphs.zh: 在 1,440 项比较任务中，有 1,360 项生成了有效的偏好标签：其中 448 项用于相机一致性，静态一致性和动态一致性各为 456 项。 被排除的任务包括 19 份问题报告和 61 个三分割任务。 表 7 报告了由此得到的模型层面相关性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 separates the three consistency dimensions. Spearman correlations are 0.902, 0.965, and 0.832 for camera, static, and dynamic consistency. The corresponding Pearson correlations are 0.959, 0.951, and 0.904. Human and automatic evaluation rank Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra first and second in all three dimensions, and identify the same top-four ordering for static consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 区分了三个一致性维度。 相机、静态一致性和动态一致性对应的斯皮尔曼相关系数分别为 0.902、0.965 和 0.832。 相应的皮尔逊相关系数为 0.959、0.951 和 0.904。 在人类评估和自动评估中，Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 在所有三个维度中分别排名第一和第二，并且在静态一致性方面识别出相同的前四名排序。
